## Overview
Rakebig Services (https://www.rakebig.com) is an engineering and AI automation agency. We design, build, customize, and support Perfex CRM systems, SaaS platforms, web applications (Laravel/Vue), mobile applications (Flutter), and practical AI workflow automations for growing companies worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. Perfex CRM Solutions (https://www.rakebig.com/services/perfex-crm-solutions)
   - Custom module development, tenant management, workflow automation, and multi-tenant SaaS for Perfex CRM.

2. SaaS Platform Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/saas-platform-development)
   - Multi-tenant software architecture, subscription management, tenant isolation, and billing portals.

3. Web Application Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/web-application-development)
   - High-performance web applications, client portals, and administrative dashboards on Laravel and Vue.js.

4. Mobile App Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/mobile-app-development)
   - Production cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built with Flutter, integrated directly with backend CRMs and REST APIs.

5. App Clone Development (https://www.rakebig.com/services/app-clone-development)
   - On-demand marketplace, delivery (Zepto/Blinkit/Swiggy), chat, and social applications engineered for scale.

6. App Publish Solution (https://www.rakebig.com/services/app-publish-solution)
   - Google Play Store & Apple App Store compliance, automated build pipelines, and publishing assistance.

7. AI Business Automation (https://www.rakebig.com/services/ai-business-automation)
   - Practical AI workflows, automated lead routing, ticket triage, document extraction, and custom AI agents.

8. Business Integrations (https://www.rakebig.com/services/business-integrations)
   - WhatsApp Cloud API, VoIP / IP telephony, Razorpay/Stripe payment gateways, and custom webhook workflows.

9. Cloud Deployment & DevOps (https://www.rakebig.com/services/cloud-deployment-devops)
   - Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), aaPanel, Coolify, VPS setup, SSL, and cloud management.

10. Maintenance & Support (https://www.rakebig.com/services/maintenance-support)
    - 24x7 monitoring, SLA-backed bug fixes, security patches, and database optimization.

11. Dedicated Team (https://www.rakebig.com/services/dedicated-team)
    - Full-stack engineers, UI/UX designers, and DevOps leads embedded into client engineering squads.

12. IT Consulting (https://www.rakebig.com/services/it-consulting)
    - Architectural reviews, tech audits, security compliance, and technology roadmaps.
## AI Solutions & Autonomous Agents
Hub: https://www.rakebig.com/solutions

1. AI Business Automation (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/ai-business-automation)
   - Route tickets, triage inbox messages, draft business reports, and automate cross-app workflows with AI.

2. App Publish Solution (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/app-publish-solution)
   - Store compliance, automated iOS/Android build pipelines, and 24x7 AI support agents managing user reviews.

3. AI Assistants & Chatbots (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/ai-assistants-chatbots)
   - Multi-channel conversational AI trained on company knowledge, handling WhatsApp, web chat, and Zendesk 24x7.

4. Document & Data Extraction (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/document-data-extraction)
   - Zero-shot unstructured parsing converting invoices, PDFs, statements, and receipts into validated JSON/database records.

5. Custom AI Integrations (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/custom-ai-integrations)
   - Embed OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and local LLMs into proprietary enterprise stacks and databases.

6. AI Workflow Automation (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/ai-workflow-automation)
   - Autonomous multi-agent pipelines with human-in-the-loop approvals, routing tasks seamlessly across enterprise tools.

7. AI Strategy & Consulting (https://www.rakebig.com/solutions/ai-strategy-consulting)
